hook_text: The grey wall was bugging me

song.title: Paint It
song.style: English, bright funk with slap bass, wah guitar, tight horn stabs and cowbell, warm friendly male lead vocal, joyful and groovy, 122 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Grey old wall across the way
Stared at it most every day
Scrolling colours on a screen
While my street was never seen

[Chorus]
Paint it, paint it, red and blue
Drips of yellow on my shoe
Paint it, paint it, big and bright
Phone's asleep till late tonight

[Verse]
Grandma drew a purple cat
Baker made a giant hat
Kids left handprints, green and gold
A sunflower, ten feet tall and bold

[Chorus]
Paint it, paint it, red and blue
Whole street's got a job to do
Paint it, paint it, step on back
No more grey, and that's a fact

shots.prompt: A long blank grey wall faces a row of crooked clay houses across a narrow street, dull under a grey sky. The camera cranes down to it. Flat grey light.
{moss} stands at his window with a mug, staring out at a blank grey wall across the street. The camera dolly zooms on him from outside. Flat grey light.
shots.frame: He stands at a window holding a mug, seen from outside through the glass, looking out with a bored face. Medium shot. Flat grey light.

shots.prompt: {moss} sits on a doorstep with his chin in his hands, staring at a blank grey wall across a narrow street. The camera orbits around him. Flat grey light.
A grey pigeon on top of a blank grey wall yawns and tucks its head under its wing. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Flat grey light.
A softly glowing phone held in two clay hands swirls with rainbow colours. Extreme close-up, the camera spins around it. Dim grey light.
{moss} sits on a green sofa, his round glasses reflecting swirling rainbow colours from a softly glowing phone. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Dim grey light, warm lamp.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, wistful, a blank grey wall filling the window behind him. The camera pushes in. Flat grey light, warm lamp.
{moss} looks from his phone to the grey wall outside his window and back, and a grin spreads under his mustache. The camera whip-pans between them. Warm lamp light.
{moss} kicks open a shed door and marches out carrying a red tin of paint and a blue tin of paint, a brush between his teeth. The camera crash zooms in. Bright morning sun.
shots.frame: He stands in the doorway of a garden shed holding a red tin of paint in one hand and a blue tin of paint in the other, a paintbrush held in his teeth. Full body. Bright morning sun.

shots.prompt: A fat paintbrush dips into a tin of bright red paint and comes up dripping. Extreme close-up, the camera tilts up with it. Bright morning sun.
{moss} slaps a big stripe of yellow paint onto a grey wall and a blob drips onto his green boot. The camera tilts down from the brush to his boot. Bright morning sun.
shots.frame: He stands side-on at a blank grey wall holding a fat paintbrush loaded with yellow paint up against it, a tin of yellow paint at his feet. Full body. Bright morning sun.

shots.prompt: A blob of yellow paint lands on the toe of a green rubber boot. Extreme close-up, the camera crash zooms in. Bright morning sun.
{moss_back} paints a huge red swirl on a grey wall with a roller on a long pole, stretching up on tiptoe. The camera cranes up along the wall. Bright morning sun.
{moss} turns away from a wall with red and blue paint splattered on his raincoat, beaming. The camera pushes in fast. Bright morning sun.

A black smartphone stands upright, face to the door, in a quilted moss-green brick stuck to a cream fridge door, a round sun-yellow badge with a closed eye on its front, a small shopping list held by a yellow magnet beside it. Soft leaf shadows sway slowly across the fridge door. Warm morning light. The camera pushes in slowly.
A grey pigeon on top of a wall looks down at a wet red swirl of paint and tilts its head. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.
A grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses paints a big purple cat on a grey wall with a tiny brush, tongue out. The camera pushes in. Bright midday sun.
A big purple cat with a curly tail painted on a wall, still wet and shining. The camera orbits past it. Bright midday sun.
A baker in a white apron and a tall white hat paints a giant white chef's hat on a grey wall with a broom dipped in paint. The camera cranes up the wall. Bright midday sun.
{moss} and a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat clink their paintbrushes together like a toast. The camera crash zooms in. Bright midday sun.
{moss} holds out a tray of green and gold paint while two small children in red dungarees with pigtails press handprints onto a wall, giggling. The camera tracks along the wall. Bright midday sun.
A small clay hand presses a new gold handprint into a row of green and gold handprints on a wall. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright midday sun.
{moss_back} stands on a wooden ladder painting the yellow petals of a giant sunflower high on a wall. The camera cranes up the ladder to him. Golden afternoon light.
A giant painted sunflower with a smiling face towers on a wall above a street. The camera tilts up its stem to the flower. Golden afternoon light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, joyful, speckled with red, blue and yellow paint, a colourful painted wall behind him. The camera orbits around him. Golden afternoon light.
Clay hands holding paintbrushes of every colour swish across a wall together. Close-up, the camera whip-pans along the wall. Golden afternoon light.

{moss_back} paints at one long wall beside a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses and a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat, ladders and tins of paint all along the street. The camera tracks fast along the wall. Golden afternoon light.
A grey pigeon with blue paint on its feet walks along the top of a wall leaving little blue footprints. Close-up, the camera tracks with it. Golden afternoon light.
{moss} steps backward across the street, paintbrush in hand, looking up in awe. The camera tracks backward with him. Golden evening light.
A long wall covered in a bright mural: a giant sunflower, a purple cat, a white chef's hat, a red swirl and rows of handprints. The camera cranes up and back to reveal it all. Golden evening light.

{moss}, a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses and a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat sit side by side on a doorstep with mugs, speckled with paint, smiling at something across the street. The camera pulls back slowly. Golden evening light.
shots.frame: He sits in the middle of a doorstep in his mustard-yellow raincoat holding a mug, speckled with paint, smiling. On one side of him sits a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses, on the other side sits a baker in a white apron and a tall white hat, each holding a mug. Three people in a row. Medium shot. Golden evening light.

shots.prompt: {moss_back} sits on a doorstep at dusk with a mug, looking at a bright mural of a giant sunflower glowing under a streetlamp, and takes a deep breath. The camera cranes slowly up. Warm streetlamp glow, deep blue dusk.

caption: moss stared at the grey wall for years. then his phone went in the Hibernator and the paint came out. the pigeon helped
